invariants: No changed path may match reference/finalized-platform/**.
No build, dependency installation, generated output, deployment, credential access, or live-system access may occur in the immutable baseline.
A baseline result is pass only when all available required workspace checks pass and protected paths remain untouched.
Blocked application-level checks are reported as blocked, never converted into a pass.

availableChecks.purpose: Validate task lifecycle, routing, worktree, and local governance controls.
Run all available deterministic workspace verification and report unavailable capabilities.
Reject whitespace errors in the task diff.
